summary: TTM Technologies filed an 8-K to report entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement and, via Item 8.01, the completed acquisition of Epiq Solutions. On September 30, 2026, TTM borrowed a $300 million incremental senior secured Term Loan A and an $800 million seven-year Term Loan B to fund the acquisition. The facilities are guaranteed by domestic subsidiaries, including Epiq, and secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all assets, with a 65% cap on foreign stock pledges. Precise purchase-price, premium and board-advisor terms were not disclosed in the excerpt; watch integration and leverage risk.
